decisions.reason: Narrowing the requested HubSpot reporting to a basic sales funnel does not change the existing lead-management properties, stages, lists, notes, or task-assignment behavior.
The reporting-scope decision does not change whether email and LinkedIn communication histories are visible in HubSpot.
The basic sales-funnel report remains within HubSpot and does not alter the selected CRM platform, subscription plan, or CRM use.
The source decision concerns report scope and does not change synchronization of MeetAlfred reply statuses into HubSpot.
Defining the HubSpot report as a basic sales funnel does not change list-transfer behavior between HubSpot and MeetAlfred.
The reporting clarification does not affect contact transfer from Apollo to HubSpot or its expected latency.
The scope of HubSpot reporting does not change the deferred automated email-campaign requirement.
The reporting clarification does not modify the automated LinkedIn campaign's channel, mode, or platform.
A basic HubSpot sales-funnel report does not alter MeetAlfred configuration or subscription requirements.
The source decision does not change creation or use of the Sales Navigator lead-source list.
The reporting scope does not change Zapier configuration, subscription tier, or add-on requirements.
The basic sales-funnel reporting decision does not resolve or change the deferred direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration or its subscription-plan conflict.
